svg.text: TONIGHT'S MATHEMATICAL FINDING — the stranded divisors (a false claim caught before its proof)

g.text: Reachable terminal states carry "STRANDED" divisors (residual tail ≠ 0) that the leaf's analytic ledger FILTERS OUT —
but the geometric fold blows up EVERY divisor. So the planned Jacobian claim (a product over the analytic ledger)
was FALSE: minimal witness M=(2,3), true det = |z_A|⁵·|z_B|¹ vs the claimed |z_A|⁵; 310 families exhaustively.
The repair (elder-ruled, cert-backed): THE THREE-LEDGER SPLIT —
the Jacobian identity reads the FULL ledger · the loss + exponent-agreement + the RLCT poles read the ANALYTIC one ·
the stranded factors are pole-free (bounded on the box) and fold into a constant — so the proven finiteness glue
survives via a THIN WRAPPER, and the induction t14 had built (hedged on the full ledger) needed ZERO rework.
